entries.title: Revelation of John 15:7
segments: Seven golden bowls. These seven bowls correspond to the seven trumpets.  The first bowl affects the earth; the second, the sea; the third, the rivers and fountains; the fourth, the sun; the fifth, the throne of the beast; the sixth, the river Euphrates; the seventh, the air.
